narrative: The same roll as Monday. Cowley's corrected strip went to him yesterday. His own cues are unmoved, no new ink. He speaks the opening, and he comes back when the street is to be quiet. He does not add a word for a court that has moved. He looks at the margin where Monday's note still is. He does not write a fifth. The red thread is on the bundle, not on this strip.
